name: Metasteps
summary:
Metasteps is a no-code, web-based and accessible metaverse ecosystem that empowers creators, educators, and businesses to design immersive 3D environments that inspire, engage, and connect. By removing technical barriers and enabling creative freedom, Metasteps transforms how people learn, work, socialize, and share stories in the digital age.
